decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a new generation of the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, so management can interpret its results and keep improving it in-house.
The numbering module extends the firm's own variable-data printing software portfolio and supports its push toward serialization, so it fits existing knowledge well.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces draws directly on the firm's ink chemistry and coding competence, which serves a core customer need in harsh industrial settings.

The decoding app succeeds the earlier PharmaScan app and supports traceability, but mobile app development lies further from the firm's hardware core and such apps are often replaced or merged, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
Inline code verification complements the firm's marking systems and its compliance and traceability strategy, so it builds on related knowledge and integrates with its installed systems.
The layout design software supports common operation across the firm's printer range and was featured on the home page, which signals that it is a strategic part of the system offering.
